nodes.label: Detector Error Model (decompose_errors=True)
nodes.rationale: decompose_errors=True is mandatory for the surface code: without it the DEM contains hyperedges a matching decoder cannot represent, Y-type errors are silently mishandled, and the reported logical error rate is wrong.

nodes.label: Per-Round Normalisation (p_round)
nodes.rationale: Comparing distances/tiers with different round counts using raw P_L is the single most likely bug; per-round normalization inverts the composition of independent Bernoulli flips so results are comparable.

nodes.label: Threshold Crossing Band (never a fitted single number)
nodes.norm_label: threshold crossing band (never a fitted single number)
nodes.rationale: Three distances with finite shot counts do not support a finite-size-scaling fit, so QRP shows a crossing region rather than a fabricated single threshold value; the repetition code is labelled a pseudo-threshold since it protects bit-flips only.

nodes.label: Cost Assumptions Summary
nodes.rationale: Configuration-based pricing (provider x unit x shots x modelled seconds); no live pricing scraped; every figure labelled estimated.

nodes.label: QEC Assumptions Summary
nodes.rationale: Consolidates: simulation not hardware, noise tiers are generator knobs not device characterisations, per-round normalisation required, no true repetition-code threshold, Wilson intervals throughout, physical-qubit counts are structural not fault-tolerance estimates.

nodes.norm_label: the rail — reliability transformation rail (signature element)

nodes.label: Real vs Demo Transparency / DEMO_VS_REAL.md (§34)
nodes.rationale: docs/DEMO_VS_REAL.md classifies every major feature as Real/Local simulation/Heuristic/Static demo data/Planned integration so an evaluator is never misled.

nodes.label: Forbidden Shortcuts (§71)
nodes.rationale: Explicit prohibition list: no faked live QPU status, no invented partnerships/quantum-advantage claims, no unlabeled random numbers as scientific output, no dead navigation, no presenting heuristic scores as experimentally validated, no claiming QEC readiness as a standardized industry metric.

nodes.label: No Number Presented as Measurement Unless Measured
nodes.norm_label: no number presented as measurement unless measured
nodes.rationale: Every quantity crossing the API carries provenance in {measured, simulated, heuristic, demo_fixture, planning_estimate}; in this prototype nothing is 'measured' since there is no hardware in the loop.

nodes.label: Circuit Input Safety (text-only, size/structural caps)
nodes.rationale: Pasted/uploaded OpenQASM is the only genuine untrusted-input surface; handled under one rule: it is text, never code. Validation is doubled (Zod for UX, Pydantic for enforcement) because the frontend is attacker-controlled.

nodes.label: Three-Layer Secret Safety (allowlist, CI regex, dist scan)
nodes.norm_label: three-layer secret safety (allowlist, ci regex, dist scan)
nodes.rationale: Code review cannot prove absence of a secret in a bundle; only reading the built bundle can, so the zero-secrets claim rests on an allowlist, a CI name regex, and a post-build dist/ scan (the load-bearing layer, currently a filed gap SEC-P1-04).

nodes.rationale: Stage A is a hard-constraint pre-filter that marks INFEASIBLE before scoring; Stage B scores only feasible candidates. Infeasible candidates are shown as 'closest infeasible option' but never recommended, so no weighting can rescue a violated budget.

nodes.label: Bias/Variance Estimate Model
nodes.rationale: A single scalar 'expected error' is forbidden because ZNE/PEC trade bias for variance; RMSE=sqrt(bias^2+std^2) exposes the tradeoff the product exists to surface.

nodes.label: Optimizer Assumptions Summary
nodes.rationale: Constraints are a hard pre-filter not weight terms; normalisation ranges are fixed and documented (not per-batch min-max); weighted sum chosen for auditability over sophistication; explanations are template-generated, no LLM text.

nodes.label: ExplainedScore Primitive
nodes.rationale: No composite number is rendered anywhere except through ExplainedScore; a number that cannot supply a breakdown is not rendered as a score, preventing a heuristic/planning_estimate number from looking measured.

nodes.label: RECON-8 — execution_mode & Nullable Actuals
nodes.rationale: Receipt carries mandatory execution_mode in {demo_replay, local_simulation, hardware}; actual_runtime/actual_cost are nullable and only set when execution_mode != demo_replay, killing a class of dishonesty.

nodes.label: Product-Level Honesty Rules
nodes.rationale: Provenance is a payload field not a badge; DEMO_VS_REAL.md is generated not hand-maintained; 1e-5 target error unreachable by QEM; Cost Saved is a modeled delta; nav renders implemented routes only; no telemetry on Pages; QEC Readiness is a QRP construct, never a standardized industry metric.

nodes.label: Precomputed Fixture Grid (threshold_grid.json)
nodes.rationale: GitHub Pages is a static host and cannot run Stim/PyMatching/sinter; faking results or hand-rolling a WASM simulator were rejected, so V1 precomputes a seeded fixture grid through the real backend and commits it.

nodes.label: Physical-Qubit Accounting (memory-patch counts)
nodes.rationale: 2d-1 (repetition) / 2d^2-1 (rotated surface) counts exclude routing, magic-state factories, and decoding fabric; every figure is labelled planning_estimate, never a full-stack resource estimate.

nodes.label: 1e-5 Honesty Rule
nodes.rationale: target_error=1e-5 is not reachable by any QEM technique on NISQ hardware (needs ~1e10 shots and no bias model is accurate to 1e-5); any surfaced 1e-5 must be a labeled QEC planning_estimate, never a QEM result.

nodes.label: Strategy Combination Ordering Constraints
nodes.rationale: Ordering is not cosmetic: e.g. readout error must be corrected per scale factor before ZNE extrapolation (it doesn't scale with lambda), and DD must be re-inserted after ZNE folding since folding creates new idle windows.

nodes.label: Global Depolarizing Approximation
nodes.rationale: First-order model: noisy expectation value = ideal value attenuated by exp(-E_total); assumes independent additive error channels and |<O>_ideal|=1 as a conservative bound, not a physical derivation.

nodes.label: Pauli Twirling / Randomized Compiling (modifier)
nodes.rationale: Twirling converts coherent error into stochastic Pauli error but does not reduce average bias; modelled as a modifier that raises strategy_confidence in ZNE/PEC, not a standalone strategy.

nodes.label: Probabilistic Error Cancellation (PEC, calculator only)
nodes.rationale: PEC does not execute in V1; it ships only as an overhead/feasibility calculator because the sampling overhead gamma^2 grows exponentially with circuit size, making real execution infeasible to fake honestly.

nodes.label: QEM Assumptions Summary
nodes.rationale: Consolidates: bias/variance modelled separately, global-depolarizing approximation, technique honesty encoded in the compatibility matrix, statistical vs strategy confidence kept separate.
